diagnostics.message: helm_release.karpenter explicitly depends on null_resource.wait_for_cluster, but that ordering is already established transitively: helm_release.karpenter references module.karpenter, which depends on null_resource.patch_calico_installation, which references data.external.update_kubeconfig, which explicitly depends on null_resource.wait_for_cluster. Remove the redundant depends_on entry.

helm_release.karpenter launches a controller whose service account uses the EKS Pod Identity association enabled in module.karpenter, but it has no dependency on aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent. The release and agent add-on can therefore be installed concurrently, allowing the controller to start before its AWS credential agent is available. Make the release depend on aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent to establish that operational prerequisite; this also orders it after the self-managed node group.
